t: The Brenner Glass and Window Cleaner 1 Ltr is a ready-to-use professional spray designed to clean glass surfaces. It is ideal for commercial window cleaners, tradespeople, and facility managers maintaining offices or residential properties. This powerful formula quickly removes everyday grease, finger marks, and stubborn dirt without scratching. It leaves a streak-free shine on windows, mirrors, and glazed partitions with minimal wiping, saving time on busy jobsites.
b: Non Abrasive Formula Helps Protect Glass
Lifts Stubborn Dirt & Grease From Hard Surfaces
